C1.why: Medi used أجاوب for answering the phone; Amal explicitly rejected it and prompted until he said أرد.

C2.why: Same repeated verb error (بشتغل for بستعمل) that Amal actually corrects at C5 (03:55).

C3.why: Duplicate of the بشتغل -> بستعمل slip that Amal corrects immediately after 03:55 (C5).

C4.why: Medi used singular جديد for two nouns (headphone and microphone); Amal corrected it to plural جداد.

C5.why: Medi used بشتغل (work) to mean 'use' equipment; Amal recast to تستعمل/بستعمل and typed basta3mel.

C6.why: When trying to recall 'difference', Medi offered مختلف and غير, which Amal rejected before supplying فرق.

C7.why: Amal supplied بينهم at 06:07 after Medi trailed off on بين, and Medi's بنها at 06:09 was an echo/ASR that Amal did not correct.

C8.why: Medi used masculine مش منيح for feminine عطلة; Amal prompted the gender choice and typed mish mnee7a.

C9.why: Medi switched from كل العطلة to كل عطلة for 'the entire holiday', and Amal rejected it ('No. That's every.').

C10.why: Medi conjugated the past tense of خطط as خطينا; Amal rejected it, prompted the doubled letter, and supplied خططنا.

C11.why: Duplicate of C10 at the same timestamp; the error is past-tense morphology on خطط rather than vocabulary.

C12.why: Medi omitted the fixed preposition على after رنينا (and said رننا); Amal prompted what رن takes until he added على.

C13.why: Duplicate of the 09:24 moment in C12, and رننا -> رنينا is past-tense morphology rather than a vocabulary slip.

C14.why: Medi said مية before a counted noun; Amal prompted the feminine -t rule until he produced ميت (meet).

C15.why: After ميت (100), Medi used plural مطاعم أو أماكن; Amal corrected to singular مطعم and named the 11+ rule.

C16.why: Medi used إشي مختلف for 'other things / something else'; Amal recast it to إشي تاني.

C17.why: Medi put الـ on الأول before مكان; Amal questioned الأول؟ and he corrected to أول مكان.

C18.why: Medi omitted the object pronoun suffix on لقيناه (and إشي in أحسن إشي); Amal prompted both and typed la2ainaah and a7san ishi.

C19.why: الأينا is just the ASR spelling of Levantine لقينا; Amal was prompting the missing object suffix -h (لقيناه, C18), not correcting a vocabulary word.

C20.why: After Amal's cucumber hint for 'option', Medi guessed خوار and Amal corrected it to خيار.

C21.why: Medi said إحنا بدنا (and حبنا) for past 'we wanted'; Amal rejected it and prompted until he said كان بدنا.

C22.why: Medi used صحابهم ('their friends') instead of صحابنا ('our friends'); Amal asked 'whose friends?' and supplied صحابنا.

C23.why: Conflates two separate moments already covered cleanly by C24 (كل أدا -> الكل at 17:23) and C25 (بيكون مميز at 17:59).

C24.why: Medi said كل أدا for 'everybody'; Amal prompted for the word for 'everybody' and he produced الكل.

C25.why: Medi used the adjective مميز without a form of يكون in a لما clause; Amal prompted until he supplied يكون.

C26.why: Part of the same season-naming moment as C27, where Medi knew شتا meant winter ('Not winter?') before failing on خريف.

C27.why: Trying to name the current season (autumn), Medi said خيس and Amal corrected it to خريف (5areef).

C28.why: Medi thought محادثة meant 'future'; Amal said no and explained that محادثة means 'conversation'.

C29.why: Medi guessed مستأجر for 'future'; Amal rejected it and supplied مستقبل.

C30.why: Medi said الصف (الصيف) instead of الشتاء; Amal questioned it and he corrected to الشتاء.

C31.why: Medi said أكتر مشغولين for 'the busiest'; Amal prompted 'The most' and he fixed it to مشغولين أكتر إشي.

C32.why: Medi used masculine عليه for feminine شجرة; Amal prompted شجرة twice and typed 3alaiha.

C33.why: After بدأت, Medi did not use a present verb; Amal named the two-verb rule and he changed it to ندرس.

C34.why: With subject إحنا and ندرس, Medi kept first-person singular بدأت; Amal corrected the agreement to إحنا بدينا.

C35.why: بعدين أدرس is an ASR mishearing of بدينا ندرس, and Medi answered مع بعض immediately when Amal asked for 'together'.

C36.why: Medi thought بالظبط meant 'intention / what you meant'; Amal rejected this and explained it means 'exactly'.

C37.why: Medi swapped the meanings of متشجع and حافز; Amal said بالعكس ('the opposite') and he corrected them.

C38.why: Medi said كتير إشي with singular إشي; Amal echoed كتير and he fixed it to plural كتير أشياء.

C39.why: Asked for 'stressed', Medi said متوترة ('nervous'); Amal pointed out that means nervous and supplied مضغوط.

C40.why: Medi used transitive بيغيروا for things changing; Amal said no and he fixed it to intransitive بيتغيروا.

C41.why: Medi used feminine واحدة منهم to refer to one of the things (إشي); Amal corrected it to masculine واحد.

C42.why: Medi used masculine راح يكون with feminine حياتي; Amal prompted on حياة and he fixed it to تكون.

C43.why: Medi used masculine سهل for feminine حياتي; Amal recast it to feminine سهلة.

C44.why: Medi switched from حالي to على حالك after أذكر; Amal corrected back to direct object حالي.

C45.why: Medi mispositioned or omitted الـ in كل هدول الأشياء; Amal corrected to كل هدول and prompted الـ before الأشياء.

C46.why: Medi asked a grammar question in English about whether يكونوا was needed, and إمنا is an ASR rendering of his pronunciation of مناح.

C47.why: Medi immediately rejected اكتر اشي himself before Amal reacted, then produced زيادة when she repeated 'Extra'.

C48.why: Medi said دائمًا أحس without the present b- prefix; Amal recast it to بحس.

C49.why: Medi kept second-person تشتغل after أنا لازم; Amal corrected it to first-person أشتغل.

C50.why: Medi said لما عندي without يكون for future 'when I have'; Amal supplied يكون عندي.

C51.why: Medi reversed كنت راح to راح كنت and then omitted the verb after كنت راح; Amal corrected both.

C52.why: In the relative clause with اللي, Medi omitted the preposition and pronoun on بغلط فيها/فيه; Amal recast with فيها and فيه.

C53.why: Medi said أضرب ('hit') instead of أتدرب ('practice'); Amal corrected the verb twice to أتدرب.

C54.why: Medi attached -هم directly to the verb instead of using the preposition على; Amal hinted 'collocations' until he said عليهم.
